added.title: Director of Product Engineering - Remote
added.description:
TGI Sport builds technology that sits inside live sport — from the live broadcast path to the applications through which millions of fans watch.

In this newly created role, you’ll lead the engineering behind our client-facing products across mobile, web and connected TV, alongside our direct-to-consumer and distribution technology.

This is an opportunity to solve a genuine engineering challenge, build a new team in Austin and have real influence over how our technology evolves globally.

Your Mission

Your focus will be making our technology easier, faster and more consistent for partners to integrate. You’ll help move us from bespoke client builds towards scalable, repeatable products and integrations, while continuing to deliver for some of the biggest organisations in sport. You’ll:

Shape our SDK, API and client integration strategy across mobile, web and connected TV.
Lead the engineering behind our direct-to-consumer and distribution products.
Own the technical direction, architecture and engineering standards across the vertical.
Help establish Austin as a key engineering hub, with significant budget to build and shape your own team.
Own the AWS architecture behind your products, balancing reliability, performance and cost.
Work directly with partner engineering teams on integrations and complex technical challenges.
Build relationships with senior technology leaders at major sports organisations.
Partner closely with Product on turning the roadmap into scalable, well-engineered products.

What You’ll Bring

Essential

A strong engineering background with experience leading technical teams.
The ability to explain complex technology simply, whether you’re speaking to an engineer, a client or a CTO.
Strong, current experience with AWS and production systems at scale.
Experience building and operating client-facing technology.
Experience with SDKs, APIs, developer platforms or complex third-party integrations.
The technical credibility to challenge architecture and engineering decisions while knowing when to delegate.
An appetite for building teams and developing engineering capability.
Comfortable working internationally and travelling to meet clients and teams when needed.

Desirable

Experience across mobile, web or connected TV.
Live video, streaming or broadcast technology.
Advertising technology, particularly addressable advertising or server-side ad insertion.
Real-time or low-latency distributed systems.

About TGI Sport

TGI Sport is a global sports technology business trusted by many of the world’s leading sporting organisations.
With more than 500 employees across 15+ international offices, we deliver technology, media rights, advertising and fan engagement solutions that power more than 5,000 sporting events every year.
Our technology operates in a world where reliability matters. When the event is live, what we build needs to work.

What else do I get from TGI Sport?

$180,000 base salary plus bonus and benefits.
The opportunity to help build and shape our new engineering capability in Austin.
Genuine ownership of our Product Engineering architecture and technical direction.
A senior role where you can remain close to the technology rather than stepping away from it.
Direct exposure to the technology teams behind some of the biggest organisations in global sport.
The chance to solve complex engineering problems across cloud, streaming, consumer applications and live sport.
An international role with the opportunity to travel and work with clients and engineering teams around the world.

TGI Sport is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

added.title: Technical Director (Bespoke Software Solutions) $250k Remote – US East Coast
added.description:
Ingenio is partnering with a leading global digital engineering consultancy to hire a Technical Director for its US team.

This is a senior technical leadership role for someone who can operate comfortably in the boardroom and with engineering teams — shaping technical strategy, advising enterprise clients, and leading the delivery of complex, custom-built digital products and platforms.

You’ll work with multidisciplinary teams across software engineering, platforms, architecture, DevOps, data, AI and design, helping major organisations modernise legacy technology and build scalable digital solutions.

What you’ll own:

You’ll provide technical and delivery leadership across multiple enterprise engagements, including:
Setting technical vision and guiding architecture and engineering decisions.
Acting as a trusted technology advisor to CIOs, CTOs and senior client stakeholders.
Leading discovery workshops and translating business challenges into practical technical strategies.
Overseeing the delivery of complex, bespoke software products and platforms.
Ensuring solutions meet expectations around scalability, security, maintainability and engineering quality.
Identifying delivery risks early and driving projects towards successful outcomes.
Leading and mentoring senior engineers and multidisciplinary technical teams.
Partnering with resourcing teams to build the right teams around each engagement.
Managing project financials, resource allocation and commercial performance.
Supporting post-sales, solution design, proposals and account growth.
Helping clients understand where cloud, data, AI and modern engineering practices can create genuine business value.
Providing technical leadership across the full technology landscape, with the ability to move between software, platforms, cloud, architecture, APIs, data and emerging technologies.

What we're looking for

This isn’t an off-the-shelf implementation role.
We’re looking for someone whose career has been built around engineering, bespoke software development and complex digital transformation.

You’ll ideally bring:

15+ years of experience across software engineering, architecture and/or technical leadership.
A genuine engineering background, with strong technical foundations rather than a purely programme, project or commercial background.
Broad technical depth across areas such as software engineering, platforms, cloud, architecture, APIs, distributed systems, databases and modern application development.
A strong consultancy or professional services background.
Proven experience leading custom-built software programmes for enterprise clients.
Deep knowledge of modern software architecture, cloud platforms and engineering practices.
Experience with distributed systems, databases and modern application development.
Demonstrable AI experience, including exposure to AI-enabled solutions, AI/ML technologies, or the application of emerging AI capabilities within enterprise software and digital transformation.
Experience leading discovery, post sales and solution design conversations.
Strong commercial awareness, including budgets, project financials and resource planning.
Experience building and mentoring high-performing technical teams.
The credibility to challenge, advise and influence senior technology leaders.

Most importantly, you’ll know how to balance technical excellence with commercial reality.
You can go deep with engineers when needed, but you can also sit with an executive team, understand the business problem and explain the technical path forward without hiding behind jargon.

Why consider it?

You’ll join an established global digital engineering business with hundreds of specialists working across multiple countries and major enterprise clients.
The environment is remote, highly collaborative and built around solving difficult engineering problems rather than implementing packaged platforms.

The package includes:

Annual company bonus
Private healthcare
401(k) with up to 4% employer match and immediate vesting
Flexible remote working
Flexible time off
Remote workspace allowance
Training and professional development allowance

If you’ve built your career at the intersection of engineering, technology, consulting, AI and enterprise transformation — and want more influence over what gets built, how it gets built and the impact it creates — we’d like to hear from you.
📩 Apply now or contact Ingenio for a confidential conversation.

added.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Media Foundation
added.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

The Media Foundation team builds the core platforms and infrastructure that power photo and video capture, upload, processing, storage, and delivery across Airbnb's products, at a massive global scale. We partner closely with Product, Design, Data Science, Trust, and Infrastructure teams to ensure every image and video guests and Hosts see is fast, high-quality, and reliable, from the moment a Host uploads a photo to the moment a Guest views it in search results.

The Difference You Will Make

As the Senior Engineering Manager for Media Foundation, you will lead a team of engineers to build and operate Airbnb's media infrastructure, the foundation powering every photo, video, and document that users interact with on the platform. Capabilities include uploads, AI/ML transformations, distribution, and presentation within the product. You will shape the team’s vision and help steer the organization towards our larger goals. This includes day-to-day operations, technical deep dives, community engagement with internal engineering teams, and strategic planning.

As the technical and organizational leader for Media Foundation, you own the reliability, scalability, and evolution of the systems that power every media interaction on the Airbnb platform from the moment a host uploads a photo to the instant a guest streams a listing video. Your experience in both media technology and people management will be essential to the maintenance, modernization, and innovation of Airbnb's media platform. You set the bar for engineering excellence, define what great looks like for your team, and create an environment where engineers grow, do their best work, and are proud of what they ship.

A Typical Day

Set technical strategy and architecture for media infrastructure across multiple teams, aligning investment with product and business priorities.
Lead, coach, and grow other managers and senior technical leads, and create an environment where engineers can do their best work.
Partner with Product, Design, Trust, and other infrastructure orgs to shape a resilient, scalable media platform roadmap.
Champion engineering excellence and operational rigor, and resolve systemic technical debt affecting reliability, performance, or velocity.
Retain, grow, and hire a diverse team of high-performing engineers and managers to execute an ambitious media platform vision.

Your Expertise

12+ years of industry experience, with a minimum of 6+ years in engineering management, including managing other managers or senior technical leads.
Bachelor's and/or Master's degree, preferably in CS, or equivalent experience.
Deep expertise in large-scale distributed systems, with a track record of setting technical strategy and architecture across multiple teams; media/content infrastructure experience (ingestion, processing, storage, CDN delivery) is a strong plus.
Strong product instinct and communication skills, with proven experience influencing senior cross-functional and cross-organizational partners to deliver high-quality, user-facing platform capabilities.
Track record of leading and shipping large, cross-team initiatives with significant business impact, and building a culture of operational excellence, quality, and reliability.
Sound judgment balancing short-term business needs with long-term technical and organizational health, with a flexible leadership style suited to varying team maturity.
Demonstrated ability to identify, retain, grow, and acquire critical engineering and management talent, with a strong commitment to fostering diversity, equity, and inclusion within teams.

Your Location:

This position is US - Remote Eligible. The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager. While the position is Remote Eligible, you must live in a state where Airbnb, Inc. has a registered entity. Click here for the up-to-date list of excluded states. This list is continuously evolving, so please check back with us if the state you live in is on the exclusion list. If your position is employed by another Airbnb entity, your recruiter will inform you what states you are eligible to work from.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

We strive to also provide a disability inclusive application and interview process. If you are a candidate with a disability and require reasonable accommodation in order to submit an application, please contact us at: reasonableaccommodations@airbnb.com. Please include your full name, the role you’re applying for and the accommodation necessary to assist you with the recruiting process.

We ask that you only reach out to us if you are a candidate whose disability prevents you from being able to complete our online application.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Airbnb values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Airbnb are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, gender, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic.

How We'll Take Care Of You

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus, equity, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

Pay Range

$248,000—$310,000 USD

Reasonable Accommodations:
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams:
Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

About Our Client:

Panorama Education operates in the K-12 education technology sector, addressing the challenge of providing comprehensive student insights to modern school systems. By integrating academic, attendance, behavior, and engagement data with AI, the program enables educators to fully understand each student and make informed decisions. Supporting 15 million students across 2,000 districts nationwide, the organization has a significant impact on student outcomes.

About the Opportunity:

The SENIOR ENGINEERING MANAGER, PLATFORM leads the team responsible for the foundational capabilities that support the organization's products, including shared services, core infrastructure, developer tools, and operational standards. This role ensures the platform remains robust and scalable as the program grows, enabling rapid and secure product development. Lead and grow a team of senior and staff platform engineers, setting clear expectations and providing direct feedback.
Guide technical decisions on architecture, infrastructure, and system design, focusing on high-impact work.
Manage platform delivery from planning to production, defining and maintaining platform health metrics.
Develop strong operational practices including on-call and incident management with SRE.
Collaborate with AI platform and security teams to ensure infrastructure supports AI capabilities securely and efficiently.
Work with product management to shape and prioritize the platform roadmap.
Represent platform engineering in cross-team initiatives and provide leadership with transparent updates.
Ensure platform capabilities comply with security, privacy, and regulatory requirements, especially regarding student data.

Minimum 8 years software engineering experience, including 5 years managing engineers, preferably in platform-related teams.

Experience partnering with product teams to deliver shared roadmaps and coordinating across engineering, security, and operations.
Disciplined in delivery, scope management, and defining completion criteria.
Focus on developer experience improvements such as CI/CD and internal tooling tied to productivity and retention.
Knowledge of security and compliance frameworks like SOC 2 and FERPA, with expertise in data protection.

Wellness and work-from-home reimbursements.

added.title: AI/ML Engineering Director
added.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an AI/ML Engineering Director based in the United States.

This is a director-level opportunity focused on applying AI, machine learning, automation, and analytics to modernize customer and employee support environments.

The role combines hands-on technical architecture, solution prototyping, strategic consulting, and executive-level engagement.

You will assess complex operating environments and translate business and mission challenges into scalable AI-enabled solutions.

You will help shape modernization roadmaps spanning conversational AI, agentic automation, intelligent workflows, analytics, and self-service.

The position also plays an important role in business development, including proposals, discovery sessions, business cases, and executive presentations.

Success requires the ability to bridge advanced AI capabilities with practical operational models, measurable outcomes, and compliance requirements.

This is a fully remote position supporting government and commercial clients, with approximately 10–25% travel expected.

Accountabilities

Assess current-state service desk and contact center environments across people, processes, technology, operating models, and cost structures.
Design future-state support models that leverage AI, automation, self-service, workflow orchestration, and intelligent assistance.
Develop modernization strategies and technology roadmaps aligned with mission requirements, user experience objectives, and operational efficiency goals.
Analyze client data and develop business cases, ROI models, and value propositions that demonstrate measurable cost savings and operational improvements.
Advise clients on reducing manual and repetitive support activities through intelligent automation and AI-driven solutions.
Lead discovery sessions, stakeholder interviews, operational assessments, workshops, and executive briefings.
Prototype AI and automation solutions, develop proofs of concept, and demonstrate technical approaches to internal and external stakeholders.
Support capture and business development activities, including proposals, requests for information, whitepapers, and related sales initiatives.
Contribute to transformation programs involving IT service management, customer experience, omnichannel support, and enterprise service management.
Translate operational pain points into scalable technical architectures and process improvements.
Create architectural documentation, transformation strategies, business cases, technical recommendations, and executive-level presentations.
Collaborate with engineers, delivery teams, technical specialists, and client stakeholders to align solutions with mission outcomes, business objectives, and compliance requirements.
Evaluate and recommend technologies including conversational AI, chatbots, virtual agents, intelligent routing, knowledge-centered service, robotic and agentic automation, workflow platforms, agent assist solutions, predictive analytics, and reporting tools.
Help establish measurable outcomes around automation adoption, self-service, resolution times, customer experience, operational efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainable modernization.
Support portfolio growth and business development through successful client engagements and sales activities.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
5+ years of related professional experience required; 15+ years preferred.
8+ years of experience in artificial intelligence, machine learning, intelligent workflow automation, or a closely related technical field preferred.
US citizenship required.
Ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret security clearance.
Experience applying modern AI methods to real-world challenges in complex technical environments, ideally across government or commercial industries.
Demonstrated experience designing or implementing AI and automation solutions within support or service organizations.
Strong understanding of support operating models and the ability to redesign them for greater efficiency, scalability, and automation.
Hands-on experience with AI/ML technologies and methodologies, including virtual agents, LLM orchestration, agentic AI patterns, conversational design, AI evaluation frameworks, prompt engineering, and context engineering.
Familiarity with AI-enabled support capabilities, copilots, safety frameworks, compliance requirements, and AI guardrails.
Experience developing business cases, ROI analyses, cost models, or value assessments for automation and transformation initiatives.
Demonstrated ability to prototype solutions, develop proofs of concept, and communicate technical architectures to both technical and executive audiences.
Strong client-facing consulting, facilitation, presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
Experience owning or supporting a portfolio of work, including responsibility for cost models, financial performance, or P&L.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, strategic planning, and decision-making capabilities.
Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, delivery, business development, and client teams.
Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment and traveling approximately 10–25% as required.

Benefits

Competitive annual salary range of $170,144–$230,000, with actual compensation determined by experience, geographic location, and applicable contractual requirements.
Fully remote work arrangement with a flexible work week designed to support work-life balance.
Comprehensive medical plan options, including plans with Health Savings Accounts.
Dental and vision insurance options.
401(k) plan with company matching and pre-tax and post-tax contribution options.
Paid vacation, sick, personal, and holiday leave.
Paid parental, military, bereavement, and jury-duty leave.
Up to 160 hours of paid family leave within a rolling 12-month period for eligible employees.
Short- and long-term disability coverage.
Life insurance and accidental death and dismemberment coverage.
Personal accident, critical illness, and business travel and accident insurance offerings.
Career development resources, including AI-powered career and learning tools.
Internal mobility support and opportunities for professional growth.
Opportunity to work on high-impact AI, cloud, cyber, data, and digital transformation initiatives.
Collaborative and innovation-focused environment with opportunities to work alongside experienced technical and mission-focused professionals.
Approximately 10–25% travel, depending on business and client requirements.
